title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitios of Coral, Hago, Tuva, Diojango, Canalaan, Honaan and Dimnalamay, into a Barrio to be Known as the Barrio of San Joaquin, in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes

text.en: The sitios of Coral, Hago, Tuva, Diojango, Canalaan, Honaan and Dimnalamay are hereby converted into a barrio, to be known as barrio San Joaquin, in the Municipality of Basco, Province of Batanes.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
